requirement_text: The user shall be able to register an account using an email address and a password meeting minimum complexity rules.
All patient Protected Health Information (PHI) must be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256.
The checkout payment gateway shall process credit card transactions via Stripe within 500 milliseconds under normal load.
The system must be very fast and handle high sensor traffic without any issues.
The catalog search service shall support full-text search with autocomplete and filter faceting.
The user interface shall be user-friendly, modern, and extremely easy to learn.
The system shall log all record access attempts into an immutable audit trail with timestamp, user ID, and IP address.
The media streaming worker shall horizontally autoscale when cluster CPU utilization exceeds 75% for 3 consecutive minutes.
The transfer service shall enforce idempotency using unique transaction keys to prevent duplicate debit operations.
The platform shall provide 99.99% high availability with automated multi-zone failover under 30 seconds.
The driver mobile application shall cache delivery routes locally to support offline operation in low-connectivity areas.
Authentication tokens shall expire after 15 minutes of inactivity and require biometric or refresh token re-authentication.
The newsfeed algorithm should give good recommendations and make users happy.
Financial export reports shall be generated in PDF, CSV, and XLSX formats within 5 seconds for datasets under 50,000 rows.
The system shall integrate with external HL7/FHIR hospital protocols via secure mTLS REST endpoints.
The shopping cart shall persist uncompleted checkout sessions for up to 30 days across browser restarts.
The ingestion broker shall accept up to 50,000 concurrent MQTT connections with less than 2% packet drop rate.
The build pipeline must be robust and never fail during production deployment.
All database mutations affecting customer account balances shall be wrapped in ACID-compliant serializable transactions.
The web application shall conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards across all public customer portals.
